/* Editable typography and readable single-page mode */
.page.story-page .prose{overflow-y:hidden;overflow-x:hidden;overscroll-behavior:contain}
.page.story-page .prose p{font-size:var(--reading-size,15px)!important;line-height:var(--reading-leading,1.75)!important;margin-bottom:var(--reading-gap,15px)!important}
.page.story-page .headline{font-size:var(--heading-size,34px)!important;line-height:1.35;margin-top:13px;margin-bottom:7px}
.page.story-page .subtitle{margin-bottom:12px}
.page.story-page .rule{margin-bottom:13px}
.page.story-page .source{padding-top:10px}
.typography-drawer{width:min(360px,100%)}
.typography-drawer input[type=range]{padding:0;accent-color:#9e493b;cursor:pointer;height:20px}
.typography-drawer .settings-check{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin:15px 0}
.typography-drawer .settings-check input{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none;accent-color:#9e493b}
.typography-drawer .settings-check span{margin:0;font-weight:500}
.typography-drawer .settings-rule{border:0;border-top:1px solid #ded5c9;margin:20px 0}
@media(max-width:850px){
  .page.story-page .visual{height:var(--mobile-image-h,39%);flex:0 0 var(--mobile-image-h,39%)}
  .page.story-page .editorial{height:calc(100% - var(--mobile-image-h,39%))}
  .page.story-page .headline{font-size:var(--heading-mobile,26px)!important;line-height:1.34;margin:7px 0 5px}
  .page.story-page .subtitle{margin-bottom:6px}
  .page.story-page .rule{margin-bottom:7px}
  .page.story-page .source{padding-top:5px}
  .page.story-page .prose p{font-size:var(--reading-size,13px)!important;line-height:var(--reading-leading,1.7)!important}
  .typography-drawer{width:min(380px,100%)}
}
@media(max-width:430px){.page.story-page .visual{height:var(--mobile-image-h,36%);flex-basis:var(--mobile-image-h,36%)}}

/* Editable typography — font family, weight, size, line height, page scope */
.book .prose p{font-family:var(--body-font,var(--serif))!important;font-weight:var(--body-weight,400)!important}
.book .headline,.book .covercontent h1,.book .tocentry strong,.book .backtext h2{font-family:var(--title-font,var(--serif))!important;font-weight:var(--title-weight,500)!important}
.book .subtitle,.book .smallbody,.book .source,.book .endlabel{font-family:var(--body-font,var(--serif))}
.book .contents .headline{font-size:var(--heading-size,34px)!important}
.typography-drawer select{width:100%;border:1px solid #d9d0c3;background:#fffdf8;border-radius:8px;padding:9px 10px;color:#36342f;font:13px system-ui,sans-serif}
.typography-drawer .type-scope-hint{font:11px/1.6 var(--sans);color:var(--muted);margin:4px 0 10px}
.typography-drawer .settings-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.typography-drawer .type-reset{border:1px dashed #beafa1;background:transparent;padding:9px;border-radius:9px;color:#755c4f;font:12px var(--sans);cursor:pointer}
.applied-page .case-art{background:#ece7dd;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;padding:clamp(18px,3vw,42px);justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;position:relative;min-height:0}
.applied-page .case-art .artframe{flex:1;min-height:0;border:1px solid #cbbfaa;background:#f9f7f1;position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 10px 28px #3b322510}
.applied-page .case-art.two .artframe{flex:1 1 50%}
.applied-page .artframe img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;background:#fff;display:block}
.applied-page .case-art .placeholder{padding:16px;text-align:center;font:12px/1.8 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.03em;color:#8a8174}
.applied-page .case-art .placeholder:before{content:'↗';display:block;font:26px/1.2 var(--serif);color:#a68c72;margin-bottom:10px}
.applied-page .artlabel{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;background:#faf8f2e8;font:10px/1.4 var(--sans);padding:8px 11px;color:#665e52;letter-spacing:.01em}
.applied-page .case-art .arttop{font:11px var(--sans);letter-spacing:.13em;color:#8a7568;margin-bottom:4px}
.applied-page .editorial{padding:clamp(22px,3vw,45px) clamp(22px,3vw,50px) 25px}
.applied-page .headline{letter-spacing:.025em;line-height:1.28!important}
.applied-page .subtitle{line-height:1.55}
.applied-page .prose p{line-height:var(--reading-leading,1.75)!important;letter-spacing:.018em}
.applied-page .source{font-size:10px;line-height:1.6}
.applied-page .foot{margin-top:10px}
.applied-page .read-more[hidden]{display:none}
@media(max-width:850px){
 .applied-page .case-art{height:var(--mobile-image-h,36%);flex:0 0 var(--mobile-image-h,36%);padding:10px;gap:6px;flex-direction:row;align-items:stretch}
 .applied-page .case-art .arttop{position:absolute;top:4px;left:12px;z-index:1;font-size:9px;background:#faf8f4cb;padding:2px 4px}
 .applied-page .case-art .artframe{flex:1 1 50%}
 .applied-page .artlabel{padding:5px;font-size:8px}

 .applied-page .case-art .placeholder:before{font-size:14px;margin:3px}
 .applied-page .editorial{height:calc(100% - var(--mobile-image-h,36%));padding:12px 17px 14px}
 .applied-page .headline{line-height:1.22!important}
 .applied-page .subtitle{font-size:10px}
 .applied-page .source{font-size:9px}
}

/* PORTFOLIO V4 — vertical editorial originals, clean reader surfaces */
.story-page:not(.applied-page) .editorial{padding-top:clamp(29px,3.2vw,46px)}
@media(max-width:850px){.wordmark{white-space:nowrap;max-width:105px}.wordmark span{display:none}}

.page.story-page .headline{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.bookmap .map-foot{justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;padding-top:14px;margin-top:15px}
.applied-page{display:grid;grid-template-columns:56% 44%;background:#f7f5ee}
